# PortraitLab (headshotsnap.com)

> AI professional headshot generator. Upload 3–8 selfies, get studio-style professional headshots. Paid service — there is no free tier and no free trial.

## What it does

- Generates professional headshots from your own selfies.
- Styles: LinkedIn / Corporate, Creative, Actor / Casting, Medical / Clinic, Real Estate.
- Input: 3–8 selfies; image files (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC).
- Output: downloadable headshot image files. Generation starts only after the order is paid.
- Faces: your selfies are used to generate your own headshots for the order; see /privacy for retention and training details.

## Pricing (USD, one-time; no subscription)

| Package | Price | Headshots | Included |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sample Pack | $9 | 5 | 1 style, 1 background |
| Starter | $35 | 40 | 2 outfits, 2 backgrounds, 1 free redo |
| Professional | $45 | 60 | 4 outfits, 4 backgrounds, 1 free redo |
| Executive | $75 | 100 | all outfits, all backgrounds, enhanced resolution |

- No free tier: every set is generated after payment.
- Redo: pricing lists 1 free redo for paid packages from Starter up; see /pricing for the current terms.

## Limits and behaviour

- Upload 3–8 selfies per order; more or fewer may be rejected by the form.
- Results are AI-generated images; likeness accuracy and background rendering can vary between runs.
- Payment is handled by Waffo (card). Refunds and data handling are described on /refund and /privacy.

## Accuracy notes

- AI headshots are stylised reconstructions of your selfies, not photographs of a real studio session.
- For medical / clinical or real-estate use, follow your organisation's photo and disclosure rules.
